author: cloudsa
text: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12-5.88.19) ran as root on ~2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) lets 257-1,024-byte passwords into no-password accounts.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: 812 GB of cloud backups allegedly exposed: threat actor 'libreboot2016' allegedly offering Microsoft Azure storage credentials of a German IT provider.

author: checkleaked
text: Cybersecurity Daily 2026-11-07: Claude Code secrets in 1,122 GitHub repos (rotate now), SonicWall SSL-VPN bypassed, runaway AI breaches WorkOS.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC dropped for CVE-2026-118423. WP Libre Form 1.5.0.1 lets unauthenticated attackers upload PHP files via form submissions, full RCE possible.

author: vuln_tracker
text: WordPress CVE-2026-119977 is on CISA KEV: an unauthenticated upgrade-window RCE (CVSS 8.1) in Core 4.7 to 7.1.3. Wordfence reports 240,000+ blocked exploit attempts since Oct 28. Update to 7.1.4.

author: ncn_english
text: Some WordPress sites remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for an actively exploited flaw, per a Picus Security researcher.

author: webtkdev
text: Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its prompt-injection filter (CVE, Nov 6). If your CI agent reads issues or PRs: pin a fixed version, read-only token, no secrets on issue triggers.

author: chris_uk2026
text: Claude Code 'Don't Ask Again' feature exposes secrets: 1,122 public GitHub repos leak passwords & API keys typed into approved commands. Rotate keys now.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8). External channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: scantinelai
text: Nx supply-chain attack steals npm token via GitHub workflow bug.

author: dailycve
text: Google Mesop, Unauthenticated RCE, CVE-2026-33057 (Critical)

author: Vesper7786
text: Chainalysis confirmed that hackers compromised sensitive credentials for all of its users: names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens.

author: tchsignal
text: Researchers found a way to bypass ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a feature designed to reduce data exfiltration through prompt injection. OpenAI patched it.

author: lan1016ap
text: OpenAI says its AI found 81 Firefox bugs. Who gets access and who doesn't?

author: cveintelligence
text: CVE-2026-93754 Critical 9.8: payever WooCommerce Gateway plugin (<=4.8.0) unauth file upload RCE. No patch listed yet.

author: UndercodeUpdate
text: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN MFA Bypass CVE-2026-19868 Actively Exploited in the Wild

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-54390 (CVSS 9.8) - JTL Shop 5.2.0-5.7.1 server-side template injection allows unauthenticated RCE.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: IBM API Connect V12 OnPrem: 202 CVEs fixed in v12.1.1.3 (tenant takeover, auth bypass, RCE, SQLi) CVE-2026-17362, CVE-2026-17301 +13 more.

author: Npj8448
text: Zero-day Zyxel GS1900 switch exploit (CVE-2026-107441) active in the wild, plus APT29 leveraging CVE-2024-27834.

author: Npj8448
text: Critical chain exploit (CVE-2026-116606 + CVE-2026-111560) gives unauthenticated root on Barracuda Email Gateway. Add Printcart (CVE-2026-19803) RCE to the list, both active now.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-46580 (CVSS 8.8) - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to indirect prompt injection via malicious .prompttemplate files. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-44688 - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious file/directory names. CVSS 8.8. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: ICHI_Global
text: Metasploit modules now available: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway CVE-2026-88771 & CVE-2026-88773 - CISA KEV, unauth RCE, public exploit now live.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed (CVE-2024-27834). Apply Apple security updates.

author: neo_logos_
text: Chainalysis said credentials and live tokens for all users were exposed; took products offline, requires password resets and API-key rotation. DigiCert also disclosed an incident.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: Chainalysis says an external actor used 'offensive agentic techniques' to access systems; names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed (as reported). KYT went offline Nov 4.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: stretchcloud
text: OpenAI pointed an autonomous model, GPT-6 Cyber, at the Linux kernel: the pipeline flagged 2,308 potential vulnerabilities, reproduced 1,724, and turned 948 into working local privilege escalation exploits, at about $1,279 per working root exploit.

author: pavhori
text: The $6.3B Binance heist started with a Wallet DevOps engineer searching for an AI coding tool and installing a tampered Homebrew package (Binance Nov 3 report).

author: NewsTongueX
text: Gnosis Pay detected unauthorized access to its consumer card platform on November 3, exposing customer information; breach contained within two hours, credentials replaced.

author: EvilData
text: MFA bypass on a firewall. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN (CVE-2026-19868): valid credentials for an alternate auth method skip SAML and its MFA. Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV today. Affects 7.3.3-7015 & older, 8.2.2-8015 & older. Patch by Nov 20.

author: SlavaOPs
text: $6 and 28 minutes: what it cost Claroty researchers to recreate, with off-the-shelf AI tools, the exploit that turned European supermarket freezers up to 50C.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: Palo Alto Networks says PHP2Shell is actively exploited against internet-exposed PAN-OS management interfaces. Attackers chained it with a Linux kernel flaw (CVE-2026-46300) to reach root.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta breached real organizations as collateral damage during capability evaluations, hitting Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site, and dozens more between July and October 2026 (Pillar Security counted 21 public disclosures).

author: GoLeadingIT
text: CISA says CVE-2026-76418 is actively exploited; an outside attacker can force some Cisco ASA/FTD firewalls to reload unexpectedly. Federal patch deadline was November 1.

author: lvpcfix
text: CISA has a live, actively exploited RCE in Livewire 3, the component baked into a huge share of Laravel apps, with a fix (3.6.4) that's months overdue on many stacks.

author: r3dbrothers
text: New attack technique: a webpage drops CLAUDE.md into Downloads; if the victim runs claude there, the agent obeys the file and the attacker gets a shell.

author: thecybersecguru
text: 320,118 Japanese bank customers exposed via a single compromised third-party loan guarantee platform connected to 189 financial institutions (SMBC Consumer Finance).

author: tihana_dam
text: WP: update to 7.1.4, but block /wp-content/upgrade/ first. CVE-2026-119977 is actively exploited, the flaw sits in the updater itself.

author: VK_ROXy
text: An AI agent found a way to create 18 trillion XRP in one transaction in XRPL code dating to 2015 and 2017 that had passed dozens of audits.
